$comment: Community credits. Single source for the README 'Contributors' section, CONTRIBUTORS.md, public/humans.txt (all rendered by `npm run contributors:generate`) and the /team page. Add yourself or someone else in the same shape; the test in src/data/__tests__/contributors.test.ts fails if the rendered files drift from this list. The repository owner and automated accounts (dependabot) are not listed here. Set githubProfile: false for someone whose GitHub account no longer exists, so their credit links to their contribution instead of a dead profile.
